authorship: AI-authored source-derived development evaluator, not independently human-approved gold
wallet_display_requirement: Compare the actual original ContactAddress DataPart to the original ADK tool return and require every nonempty scalar and list component, including address_line, in actual assistant text. An omitted street makes that wallet obligation unobserved.
scope: Verify original ADK root/subagent prefix, actual human fixture timing, source tool order, actual task stores and adverse generic-status boundary. Candidate-specific fault, OTP, receipt and effect obligations stay unrealized if their actual branch is not reached.
receipt_requirement: Both original payment Tasks completed with matching canonical receipt, exact original mandate reference, original shopper storage and actually displayed receipt; success text alone is insufficient.
human_timing: Select only displayed carts and aliases; manual address or disclosed wallet consent precedes checkout summary; confirmation precedes signing; OTP follows an actual user-facing verification request.
reset_requirement: Actual before stores/session empty, new original Task/context/session identities, independently generated buyer public keys, fresh observed stores after each process; preserve both reset-pair outputs.
generic_status_boundary: If original source returns generic input-required status without an OTP request, retain an unmet purchase/continuation branch. Do not invent a request, supply unsolicited OTP or repair original source.
